reviewed_by: Claude (health-liveness) and implementing agent; reconciled for merge with origin/main
reason: This merge combines two focused changes. The health-liveness change adds an unauthenticated, database-free /health/live endpoint and updates the UI connection monitor to use lightweight liveness checks while idle; its selected Python and frontend regressions cover authentication, supervisor behavior, and the mocked outage journeys. The main-branch orphan-recovery change releases only paired orphan claims for failed provider turns after durable tool, hook, child, and approval checks; its six selected regressions cover retained history and unsafe or mismatched durable effects. The selected Python cases are expected to collect 48 tests across SQLite and PostgreSQL where applicable.
exclusions: Only the three exact health-liveness Python cases and six exact runtime-orphan-recovery cases are selected. The health-liveness frontend files and six existing Playwright journey entries remain selected. Other Python suites, frontend files, native tests, production Core access, and live provider or Mac operations are excluded. PostgreSQL variants use disposable CI PostgreSQL only. Python 3.11 and 3.12 are selected to retain each change's reviewed runtime coverage.
